overall_notes: The paper focuses on Aspect Sentiment Quad Prediction (ASQP) using generative models. It uses both automatic metrics (F1-score, Accuracy) and human evaluation. LLMs (ChatGPT) are used as annotators for comparison data creation, not strictly as judges of generated outputs. The human evaluation involves selecting appropriate pseudo-labels based on detailed annotation guidelines.
